description: [narrowed from route-edit-35e64bda] Edit repos/discovery-vessel/src/index.ts to make peer fan-out log a non-ok peer response instead of swallowing it. In the forwardToPeers function, the current line `      if (!res.ok) return` silently discards a non-ok response, so a peer 401/403 (usually a missing or wrong HUB_API_KEY, which is set by no deploy path) is byte-identical to "this peer has no producer". Replace that single line so that before returning it logs the peer and res.status via console.warn, appending the hint " — auth rejected; check HUB_API_KEY / peer key issuer" when res.status is 401 or 403. Do not change the merge/dedup behavior that follows a successful response.
